S20: Close-up of a different sheet of studio art: a simple cartoon-mouse silhouette with two round ears.
S21: Medium view of a wordless silhouette-art film poster containing exactly these two silhouette drawings side by side.
All three views show printed or drawn pictures on paper, not living characters. Completely wordless artwork, no numerical labels. Simple composition, minimal shading; retain all three separate panels.

adaptation: Neutral silhouette treatment of the same two printed story characters; preserves composition, narrative and military viewer, without locking final character identity.
